title: Processor and AI on Cloud
description: Who can open the Processor on Stirling Cloud, what differs from a self-hosted server, and how AI tools are billed.
article:
Stirling Cloud

Processor and AI on Cloud

For how the Processor and AI tools work, see Processor and AI assistant.

Open the Processor#

Select Processor in the left bar. The team owner can open it, including you on your own personal team. Invited members see Ask an admin for processor access, and guests are asked to create an account. See Setup and access.

To build your first pipeline, see Create your first pipeline.

What is different on Cloud#

Stirling Cloud has no Folder sources or destinations and no Custom API integrations (Sources, Integrations).

AI on Cloud#

AI tools are on for every signed-in account. AI requests, pipelines and policies use team credits and pause at the limit (Plans, credits and billing). For what AI providers receive, see Files and privacy.
